Honeycomb Recipe
desserts from A-Z, the goal : to try to make desserts i have never made before and we are on H for Honeycomb! i chose to make this 3 ingredient honeycomb and enrob it in chocolate to make my all time favorite chocolate - the Crunchie. its something you rarely can find in india so it becomes a super special treat for me :) 

Ingredients:
-100 grams caster / regular sugar
-35 grams honey or corn syrup or glucose ( when using honey, your honeycomb will have a strong honey flavour) 
-1 tsp/5 grams baking soda
-150 grams dark / milk chocolate, if enrobing

Method:
-add your sugar and honey to a saucepan and allow to melt together. you can stir the mix to ensure it melts evently
-allow it to stay on heat for a few minutes till smooth
-add your baking soda and whisk till just combined
-transfer to a tin lined with parchment paper ( i used a 7 inch for this recipe)
-let it cool for 15-20 minutes or till it has firmed up and cool to touch
-cut into any shape you desire and coat in chocolate if you want like i have done 
-store in an airtight container :) #honeycombrecipe #honeycomb #egglessrecipe #egglessdesserts #crunchiecandybar #crunchie #crunchiebar #crunchiebarrecipe #candybarrecipe #nobake
